name: base
purpose: default parameters (8 ps grid, 50 ps clk edges), vdd 0.9 V and vss 0 V. Eight samples, each read after a vin step inside the 200 ps aperture (the value at the trigger differs); a sample of 0.47 V that droops below vth over a 14 ns low phase while coarse stays high; clamps of 1.05 V to vdd and of -0.15 V to vss; vdd drops to 0.8 V while valid and coarse are low and the next 1.05 V sample clamps to 0.8 V; vdd returns to 0.9 V after a low decision; vin changes during holds; high phases of 1.504 to 8 ns, so droop is skipped for different numbers of updates; triggers 53 ps after an update instant.

name: rails-reference
purpose: vss 0.15 V and vdd 1.05 V (span 0.9 V), clk from 0.15 V to 1.05 V, so the clk and decision thresholds sit at 0.6 V. Samples whose distance from vss decides coarse (0.62 V gives 0.47 V, high; 0.55 V gives 0.40 V, low, though above 0.45 V from ground); droop toward vss, not toward ground; a clamp of 0.05 V to vss (0.15 V); vdd drops to 0.95 V (span 0.8 V, the minimum) while valid and coarse are low, and a 1.3 V sample clamps to it; valid and coarse levels 1.05 V or 0.95 V high and 0.15 V low. clk edges last 200 ps, the longest legal edge, so a threshold of 0.45 V from ground acts 33 ps early on rising edges (8 ps grid).

name: phase-grid
purpose: default parameters (8 ps grid). Ten cycles whose clk crossings and sample instants lie 53 ps to 245 ps from the nearest droop update instant: falls 53 ps after and 55 ps before an update, so that update is applied or skipped; sample instants 55 ps before an update; low phases of 3.8 to 12 ns starting at different grid phases; high phases of 1.104 to 6 ns. A droop grid anchored at the falling edge, droop during the high phase, or continuous droop are wrong on most cycles.

name: interrupt
purpose: trf 200 ps (the upper end), dt 1 ns, tau 10 ns, taperture 1.5 ns, valid_width 0.5 ns, 4 ps grid. Three samples with clk already low again (1.05 ns high phases) and the next droop update 55, 95 and 195 ps after each sample instant, while the vout ramp of the sample is still running: the first two retarget it in the same direction (0.8 V and 0.3 V samples), the third backwards (0.9 V sample at 97.5 % of its ramp). A model that starts the droop step only after the sample ramp has ended is still moving at the scored rows 1.3*trf after the update; droop of 9.5 % per 1 ns update.
